faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC) for healthcare positions in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this notification?
faq.answer: The notification has been released for the Senior Resident post, specifically focusing on Transfusion Medicine departments within the institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under TMC ACTREC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Senior Resident (Transfusion Medicine) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the TMC ACTREC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 is 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD in Immuno-Haematology And Blood Transfusion / Transfusion Medicine or an equivalent postgraduate degree.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 40 years, with age relaxations provided for reserved categories like SC, ST, OBC, and PwD.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Resident position will receive a monthly salary ranging between Rs. 1,33,623/- p.m and Rs. 1,45,530/- p.m.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for all candidates?
faq.answer: All candidates applying for the TMC ACTREC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 are required to pay a nominal application fee of Rs. 100/- online.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident post involves an MCQ test or a VIVA examination to assess the candidate's medical expertise.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official application portal link provided on the TMC ACTREC official website before the deadline.
